review_text: Groww is undoubtedly a great app with an excellent user experience. However, the F&O lot purchase limit is a major drawback, as it restricts traders' flexibility. Other trading apps offer more freedom to buy lots as per their requirements. I request Groww to remove or increase this limit, allowing users to trade as many lots as they wish, subject to exchange regulations. Everything else is great!
